text:
ana: heads-up — I started a quick onboard of meridian7b (llama-ish arch variant with a hybrid rotary parameterization). int4 conversion done with our usual pipeline, but summarization evals look off (repeats + missing entities). attaching a short example below.

ana: sample cmd I ran:
```
redwood convert --model meridian7b.ckpt --dtype int4 --quantizer qlora-lite --out meridian7b-int4.bin
redwood serve --model meridian7b-int4.bin --profile smoke
```

ana: sample output (prompt: "Summarize the article about the new transit plan"):
```
> summary: The transit plan includes new bus routes and more buses. The route changes will stop service for the downtown line. The plan removed the downtown line. The plan will remove the downtown line.
```

tariq: hmm repeating "remove the downtown line" is suspicious — could be kv-cache alignment or rotary scaling mismatch when head dims are remapped during conversion. did you use `--head-order=canonical` or `--head-order=legacy`?

ana: used default (auto). I also saw odd tokenization for small punctuation on a few prompts (soft hyphen + zero-width joiner sequences).

vikram: pinging in — hybrid rotary + projector-permutations have bitten us before. want to try two quick experiments: 1) convert with `--preserve-rotary-scale` disabled so we force re-normalize, 2) run int8-ptq as a control. can you share the `config.json` used?

ana: config snippet:
```
{"heads": 32, "head_dim": 64, "rotary_scaling": "auto", "proj_order": "kvqk"}
```

allegra: quick thought — when we re-order proj (kvqk vs qkvk) the rotary matrix can end up misaligned headwise. for hybrid heads (some heads with different rotary freq) our converter omits per-head freq tags unless explicitly set. try adding "rotary_freq_per_head": true in the config and rerun convert.

mike: also run the smoke bench with `--long-context 2048` and compare token-by-token logits for the first 200 tokens between fp16 and int4. if kv-cache offsets are off you'll see drift from token 1.

ana: ok running two conversions now (1. `preserve-rotary=false` + `rotary_freq_per_head=true`, 2. int8-ptq baseline). will post logs.

deploy-bot: noticed a canary deploy for meridian7b-int4 scheduled at 12:30 UTC. paused rollout until thread resolved.

bench-bot: perf snapshot link: https://bench.redwood.internal/dash/meridian7b/convert-6498765432 (captures latency/cost, will update after new runs) :bar_chart:

tariq: if the tokenizer weirdness persists, try converting vocab with NFKC normalization enforced (some models ship with mixed NF forms which lead to duplicate token ids when merging). command: `redwood vocab-normalize --model meridian7b --form NFKC`

ana: update — conversion 1 finished. quick eval against fp16 shows repeats reduced but entity drop still present. logits diff for first 100 tokens looks small (<1e-3) until token 43 then diverges. attaching small log: 
```
[log excerpt] token_idx=42 fp16_logit=2.13 int4_logit=1.98 delta=0.15
[log excerpt] token_idx=43 fp16_logit=1.90 int4_logit=-0.12 delta=2.02
```

vikram: jump to token 43 — that's exactly where a new attention window boundary kicked in for the prompt (we use dynamic prefix caching). could be that rotary phase wrap interacts badly with prefix caching offsets when proj_order was auto-detected.

allegra: plan: 1) run a tight bisect — convert with `--head-order=legacy` vs `canonical` and `--rotary-scale` = 0.5/1.0/1.5, 2) re-run tokenizer normalize NFKC, 3) try `--disable-prefetch-kv` during smoke to rule out cache prefetch timing.

mike: I can script the bisect matrix and run on a small cluster. estimated 6 runs x 3 configs = 18 benches, ~3 hours.

ana: thanks — kicking off. I'll attach results here once done. if we see consistent logit flip at the same token index across heads, we should add a conversion-time assertion that checks per-head rotary freq tags and fails loudly.

tariq: agreed. also add a warning to the onboard docs about mixed NF vocab + hybrid rotary heads. small note for QA: include summarization prompt set + entity-preservation checks.

vikram: thanks all — looping in ops if we need to hotfix the conversion script. :) :thumbsup:

ana: done for now — will report back with bisect artifacts and diff plots.
